acceptance: The owner has chosen: blog publishes freely, or posts about unreleased behaviour wait on next
AGENTS.md states the rule and how a blog link to a post-release core path must be written
If posts must wait, a pull request to main that adds such a post fails a named check, with a test
context:
Decision gate: owner decision first; no code before it. Evidence: at cutover no blog link broke against v0.5.0 (core-links inventory check was fresh).

Review 2026-11-13: set to blocked on the owner decision; nothing can be implemented before it. Put the question to the owner with both options and their cost: (free) blog posts keep publishing from main and AGENTS.md says a post may describe unreleased behaviour only if it says so and links to core by commit SHA; (held) posts about unreleased behaviour merge to next, which needs a rule a check can apply, since nothing mechanical can tell what a post describes. Recommendation to offer: free, with the written rule, because release-overview posts are published with the release and the pin already fails the build on a link to a path missing at the pinned release. Verification rubric: AGENTS.md text merged; if a check is added, a seeded test fails for a violating post and passes for a compliant one. Guardrails: no published post is unpublished or rewritten as part of this item; the drafts/ tree is out of scope.

Owner decision 2026-11-14: held. A post about unreleased behaviour waits on next. Implementation chosen so a check can apply it: a post declares the release it needs in front matter, and the blog publication check fails when the docs inputs' package_version is below it; on next the docs inputs are the develop bundle, so the post passes there. Merge targets (owner, 2026-11-14): site code, workflows and corrections to released documentation go to main on green ci, then main is merged into next; only documentation of unreleased behaviour waits on next.
description: Problem: the release pin holds back documentation only. Blog posts still publish from main as soon as they merge, so a post can describe unreleased core behaviour while the docs it links to describe the pinned release. Blog links to core files are also resolved against the pinned repo-files.json and core SHA, so a post that links a path added after the pinned release fails the build until the link is pinned to a SHA. Neither rule is written down. Outcome: an owner decision, recorded in AGENTS.md, and a check if the decision needs one.
